globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const scale = .75 + Number(globalThis.variant || 0) / 16;
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.className = 'target';
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  const base = document.createElement('style');
  base.textContent = '.target{height:0;width:'+11*scale+'px}';
  document.head.appendChild(base);
  const keyframes = '@keyframes demo{from{width:LOWpx}to{width:HIGHpx}}';
  const animation = (controls) => '.target{animation:demo 1s linear '+controls+'}';
  const cases = [
    ['unused', keyframes, 11],
    ['ease', keyframes+'.target{animation:demo 1s ease -.5s paused both}', 74.1922710067],
    ['bezier', keyframes+'.target{animation:demo 1s cubic-bezier(0,0,1,1) -.25s paused both}', 30],
    ['frameEasing', '@keyframes demo{from{width:LOWpx;animation-timing-function:ease}to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 74.1922710067],
    ['zeroLength', '@keyframes demo{from{width:0}to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 45],
    ['variables', '@keyframes demo{from{width:var(--low)}to{width:var(--high)}}.target{--low:LOWpx;--high:HIGHpx}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['unlayeredPriority', keyframes+'@layer one{@keyframes demo{from{width:200px}to{width:400px}}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['vendor', keyframes.replace('@keyframes', '@-webkit-keyframes')+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['generated', '@keyframes demo{from{height:LOWpx}to{height:HIGHpx}}.target{height:auto}.target::before{content:"";display:block;animation:demo 1s linear -.5s paused both}', 50, 'height'],
    ['quarter', keyframes+animation('-.25s paused both'), 30],
    ['half', keyframes+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['reverse', keyframes+animation('-.25s reverse paused both'), 70],
    ['before', keyframes+animation('1s paused backwards'), 10],
    ['beforeNone', keyframes+animation('1s paused'), 11],
    ['after', keyframes+animation('-2s paused forwards'), 90],
    ['afterNone', keyframes+animation('-2s paused'), 11],
    ['alternate', keyframes+animation('-1.25s 2 alternate paused both'), 70],
    ['alternateReverse', keyframes+animation('-1.25s 2 alternate-reverse paused both'), 30],
    ['finalAlternate', keyframes+animation('-2s 2 alternate paused both'), 10],
    ['fractionalCount', keyframes+animation('-2s 1.5 paused both'), 50],
    ['infinite', keyframes+animation('-1.25s infinite alternate paused both'), 70],
    ['implicitFrom', '@keyframes demo{to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50.5],
    ['important', keyframes+animation('-.5s paused both')+'.target{width:31px!important}', 31/scale],
    ['frameImportant', '@keyframes demo{from{width:LOWpx!important}to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50.5],
    ['duplicateFrame', '@keyframes demo{from{width:LOWpx}from{width:30px}to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), (30+90*scale)/2/scale],
    ['duplicateDefinition', keyframes+'@keyframes demo{from{width:30px}to{width:HIGHpx}}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), (30+90*scale)/2/scale],
    ['mediaFalse', '@media (width:1px){'+keyframes+'}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 11],
    ['mediaTrue', '@media all{'+keyframes+'}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['layer', '@layer one{'+keyframes+'}'+animation('-.5s paused both'), 50],
    ['quoted', '@keyframes "none"{from{width:LOWpx}to{width:HIGHpx}}.target{animation:"none" 1s linear -.5s paused both}', 50],
    ['missing', '.target{animation:missing 1s}', 11],
    ['zeroDuration', keyframes+'.target{animation:demo 0s paused both}', 90],
    ['zeroCount', keyframes+animation('-.5s 0 paused both'), 10],
  ];
  const result = {};
  globalThis.animationGeometry = {};
  for (const [name, source, expected, dimension = 'width'] of cases) {
    const sheet = document.createElement('style');
    sheet.textContent = source.replaceAll('LOW', String(10*scale)).replaceAll('HIGH', String(90*scale));
    document.head.appendChild(sheet);
    const measured = target.getBoundingClientRect()[dimension];
    globalThis.animationGeometry[name] = {measured, expected:expected*scale};
    result[name] = Math.abs(measured - expected*scale) < .03;
    sheet.remove();
    result[name+'Recovery'] = Math.abs(target.getBoundingClientRect().width-11*scale) < .03;
  }
  base.remove();target.remove();return result;
})();
